data.name: Loop_Help_Message
data.value:
LOOP FUNCTION
The Loop button allows you to repeat a specific section of the current song.
📝 HOW TO USE:
1️⃣ Start playback of a song
2️⃣ During playback, press the I key (for "In") where you want the loop to start
3️⃣ Continue listening and press the O key (for "Out") where you want the loop to end
4️⃣ Two small markers I and O appear above the progress bar
5️⃣ Click the Loop button to activate the loop (button turns light green)
6️⃣ The section between I and O will play in a loop indefinitely
🔄 TO DISABLE: Click the Loop button again
🗑️ RESET: Markers disappear automatically when you: • Load a new song • Stop playback completely (Stop button or Ctrl+Space)
⏸️ PAUSE/MUTE: • Loop pauses with playback • Loop continues silently in mute mode
